entities.name: Ratadrabik
entities.description: Ratadrabik of Urborg, one of the oldest and most enduring liches on Dominaria, dwelling in a fortress in the Urborg marshes.

entities.name: Moira
entities.description: A spirit-speaker whose power rivals Ratadrabik's, letting Urborg's ghosts and ghouls run wild.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: The swampland where Ratadrabik's fortress hides.

events.summary: Ratadrabik survives attacks by heroes and challengers who sought to end his reign.
events.quote: he has survived attacks by various heroes and challengers

relations.note: Moira's tolerance of the ghosts rivals his claim to supremacy.
